_comment: Traditional face-reading corpus. FOLKLORE, NOT SCIENCE (plan §4). Each entry reports what a named tradition CLAIMS about a facial feature value; it never asserts truth. `feature` + `value` must match the keys/values produced by core/features.py so core/tradition.py can join them. Grow this by hand over the project.

entries.claim: linked to a water element -- read as sociable, adaptable, and warm
historically read as balanced and diplomatic
associated with a wood element -- read as thoughtful, methodical, and idealistic
a broad, firm jaw is said to signal determination, stamina, and willpower
a narrow, tapered jaw was read as sensitivity and a mind inclined to ideas over force
large, open eyes are said to reflect an expressive, emotionally receptive nature
smaller eyes are traditionally read as focus, discernment, and a guarded inner world
fuller lips are said to signal warmth, generosity, and expressiveness
thinner lips were read as discretion, precision, and reserve
